description_expanded: Welcome to 3 Generations Beach House, an exceptional 30A beachfront retreat designed for large groups, multi-family vacations, and unforgettable time together. With direct beach access just a short walk from the home, two spacious living areas, and room for everyone to spread out, this home offers the perfect blend of comfort, space, and location. True beachfront. Steps from the sand. Sleeps 17. Private pool. Gulf and lake views.⭐ Why Guests Love This Home✔️️ 8-seater golf cart included (as of February 1, 2026)✔️ True beachfront location – just a 1–2-minute walk to the beach✔️ Sleeps up to 17 guests comfortably✔️ Private pool + expansive sun deck✔️ Multiple large balconies with Gulf and lake views✔️ Two living areas + kitchenette – ideal for large groups✔️ 6 complimentary bikes + beach gear included✔️ Private, gated cul-de-sac in a quiet neighborhood✔️ Professionally managed with 24/7 local service*Private pool (heat available for $45/night)🏡 Designed for Large and Multi-Generational GroupsThis spacious beachfront home features 6 bedrooms, 5 bathrooms, and multiple gathering spaces, allowing everyone to enjoy time together while still having privacy. Please note: this home has multiple levels and stairs, making it best suited for guests comfortable with stairs.1st FloorGuest Bedroom 1: King BedGuest Bedroom 2: Queen BedFull bathroomKitchenetteFrench doors opening to the private pool deck, with beach access just steps away and a peaceful lake behind the home2nd FloorGuest Bedroom 3: King BedGuest Bedroom 4: Two sets of twin bunk bedsFull kitchen3rd FloorMaster Bedroom 1: King bed + twin sofa bedMaster Bedroom 2: King bedLoft area with queen sleeper sofa and TVStunning Gulf and lake views from multiple spaces!Outdoor Living & Beach DaysSpend your days lounging by the private pool, grilling dinner on the BBQ, or heading to the sugar-white sands just moments away. The home’s beachfront location makes beach days effortless while still offering privacy and space to unwind back at the house.Expansive sun deckGas BBQ grillTwo outdoor showersLake behind the home — great for fishing!🚲 Beach Gear, Bikes & Extras Included6 bikes (4 adult cruisers, 1 adult tricycle, 1 kids tricycle)Beach chairs, umbrellas & towels, Boogie boards & beach toys, Pool floats & pool toys, Giant Jenga, Giant Connect 4, Cornhole and MORE!📍 Prime 30A LocationSeagrove Beach East – 2-minute walkDeer Lake State Park – 2-minute walkEastern Lake – 15-minute walkCamp Creek Lake – 7-minute driveAlys Beach – 8-minute driveClose to favorite dining spots like Old Florida Fish House, Café 30A, Bud & Alley’s, The Perfect Pig, Pickle’s Snack Station, and more. Enjoy shopping and dining at Greenway Station and The Big Chill, both popular 30A destinations. Read less
